taglines: Checked again this morning. The Senate is still not in session.
We looked under every laurel. Nothing.
No legions detected on any frontier. The limes remain unmanned.
The Tiber is unpatrolled and the Forum is a pedestrian zone for tourists.
Consulship vacant since AD 541. Applications are not being accepted.
All aqueducts report normal pressure. No emperor reports.
Tyrian purple production remains at hobbyist levels.
Zero triumphs scheduled. The Via Sacra is open to foot traffic.
Mare Nostrum is currently everybody's. Which is to say nobody's.
The Praetorian Guard has not auctioned anything today.
Latin remains in maintenance mode (Vatican City, pop. ~800).
Bread: available. Circuses: streaming only.
The eagle standards are in museums, behind glass, which is not where you keep them if you are back.
Status unchanged. It has been unchanged for a while.
Barbarians at the gates: none. Gates: also none.
Rome was not built in a day. It was also not rebuilt today.
The Colosseum is at partial capacity and zero lions.
Carthage: still delenda'd (146 BC). No further action required.
The Curia Julia is open 9 to 7. Quorum: not reached.
Omens consulted. The chickens ate normally. Inconclusive.
